description: VEXORA: Predict failure before it happens. An IoT predictive maintenance and health monitoring platform for industrial machinery and space technology. ESP32 nodes track vibration, temperature, and electrical current in real time, detect early anomalies, and stream machine health to a mobile dashboard. Result: higher reliability, less downtime, smarter maintenance. We’re embedded, software, and hardware engineers, looking for data visualization, UI/UX, and pitching collaborators.
summary:
Vexora is an AI-powered predictive maintenance system designed to monitor machine health, detect potential failures, and reduce unexpected downtime.

Our system combines ESP32, IoT sensors, FreeRTOS, and Edge AI to monitor temperature, electrical current, and vibration in real time. A Logistic Regression model analyzes sensor data to assess machine failure risk and classify operating conditions as SAFE or DANGER.

When a risk is detected, Vexora activates visual and audible alerts and sends automated WhatsApp notifications through n8n, allowing operators to respond quickly.

Unlike traditional reactive maintenance, Vexora aims to identify early warning signs before serious equipment problems occur.

Our mission is to make smart, reliable, and affordable predictive maintenance accessible to small factories and businesses.
details:
Vexora – Project Details

Vexora is an AI-powered predictive maintenance system designed to monitor machine health, detect potential failures, and reduce unexpected downtime.

Our system uses an ESP32 microcontroller connected to three sensors: MAX6675 for temperature, ACS712 for electrical current, and MPU6050 for vibration monitoring.

Using FreeRTOS and a Logistic Regression machine learning model, Vexora analyzes sensor readings and their changes over time to calculate a risk score and classify equipment conditions as SAFE or DANGER.

The system provides real-time monitoring through an OLED display, LED indicators, and a buzzer. It also sends automated WhatsApp alerts using n8n and the WhatsApp Cloud API, with persistent storage to prevent notification loss during internet interruptions.

We developed the system using C/C++, Arduino, PlatformIO, Wokwi, FreeRTOS, and Edge AI.

What makes Vexora innovative is its combination of affordable hardware, on-device AI predictions, and automated notifications without depending on continuous internet connectivity.

Our goal is to make intelligent predictive maintenance affordable and accessible to small factories and businesses.
